description: This file defines the class 'ModelViewEntity', which extends 'ModelEntity' to provide specialized behavior for view entities within the OFBiz framework. It includes nested classes for modeling member entities, aliases, view links, conversions, and conditions, as well as the logic for populating fields, managing aliases, linking views, and handling conditions related to view entities.

classes.name: ModelViewEntity
classes.description: Main class extending ModelEntity to represent view entities with additional metadata and logic for handling aliases, links, conditions, and conversions specific to database views.

classes.name: ModelMemberEntity
classes.description: Represents a member entity of the view, primarily holding alias and actual entity name.

classes.name: ModelAliasAll
classes.description: Represents a collection of fields from an entity that are included as aliases, optionally grouped or aggregated.

classes.name: ModelAlias
classes.description: Defines an alias for a field, including details such as entity alias, field name, function, group by, and description.

classes.name: ModelViewLink
classes.description: Models a link (join) between view entities, including key mappings and optional conditions.

classes.name: ModelConversion
classes.description: Handles conversion logic for transforming entity data between different representations, including field mappings.

classes.name: ViewEntityCondition
classes.description: Represents a condition (filter) applied to view entities, supporting complex expressions, ordering, and filtering options.

methods.name: populateFields
methods.description: Populates fields for the view entity, including reverse link population.

methods.name: populateFieldsBasic
methods.description: Performs a basic population of fields based on member entities and aliases.

methods.name: addMemberModelMemberEntity
methods.description: Adds a member entity to the view, capturing alias and entity name.

methods.name: getAliasedEntity
methods.description: Returns an aliased ModelEntity based on the given entity alias, using the model reader.

methods.name: getAliasedField
methods.description: Retrieves a specific field from an aliased entity.

methods.name: expandAllAliasAlls
methods.description: Creates individual aliases for all fields in member entities based on alias-all definitions.

methods.name: getOrCreateModelConversion
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a model conversion object for a given alias.

methods.name: populateReverseLinks
methods.description: Populates reverse link relationships between view entities and linked entities.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts data based on the defined conversions for a specific entity.

methods.name: populateViewEntityConditionInformation
methods.description: Populates filtering and ordering conditions for the view entity.
